name: hud_sensor_map_node_load_from_stream

known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker/map.cpp source-cluster pass.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x415bd0 shows fread checks for color, point count, point data, and objective index followed by SetColorRgb and bounds recompute; native smokes cover success, null-stream failure, packed color, point data, objective index, and bounds.
